request.style: English, roots rock, gritty powerful male vocal, overdriven electric guitar, bass, driving drums, Hammond organ, raw and urgent, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Out in the wilderness of Judea in the burning heat of day
A man in camel's hair was calling and he would not walk away
Locusts and wild honey and a leather belt of hide
All Jerusalem came out to him down by the Jordan's side
Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near
And they went down in the river with their sins confessed and clear

[Chorus]
I am a voice crying out in the wilderness
Make straight the way of the Lord
Make straight the way of the Lord

[Verse]
The priests came from the city asking who he claimed to be
Not the Christ and not Elijah, not the one they came to see
I baptize with water
Among you stands one you do not know
The one who comes after me
Whose sandal strap I am not worthy to untie

[Chorus]
I am a voice crying out in the wilderness
Make straight the way of the Lord
Make straight the way of the Lord

[Bridge]
The next day he saw Jesus coming toward him
Look, the Lamb of God
Who takes away the sin of the world

[Chorus]
I am a voice crying out in the wilderness
Make straight the way of the Lord
Make straight the way of the Lord

[Outro]
He must increase
I must decrease
He must increase; I must decrease
